title: Astronomers stunned after James Webb Space Telescope discovers the earliest pair of black hole-powered quasars
caption:
Astronomers have discovered a pair of supermassive black holes that challenge our understanding of the early universe. These quasars are far larger than current growth models should allow.

Source: Space - Astronomers stunned after James Webb Space Telescope discovers the earliest pair of black hole-powered quasars
